## Fourth Global Coral Bleaching Event Set a Record for Heat-Stress Exposure

The fourth global coral bleaching event was confirmed on April 15, 2024. Satellite data measured bleaching-level heat stress across roughly 84.4% of global reef area from January 2023 through September 2025—a period that began before the event’s confirmation and continued afterward.

That footprint exceeded the 68.2% recorded during the 2014–2017 event. Mass bleaching was documented in at least 83 countries and territories. The record refers to the area exposed to bleaching-level heat stress; it does not mean that every exposed reef was verified to have bleached or died.
